MMDA SUSPENDS NUMBER CODING ON CHRISTMAS, NEW YEAR HOLIDAYS

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will suspend its expanded number coding scheme on key holidays this holiday season: Dec. 24–25 (Christmas), Dec. 30–31 (Rizal Day and New Year’s Eve), and Jan. 1, 2026 (New Year’s Day).

The agency reminds motorists to plan trips, follow traffic rules and drive safely.
